But, you know, hopefully, when all things are said and done, we'll be able to go in and make something really cool for you guys again.|Cameron Monaghan|<ref name="Ocala Comic Con" />}}
An upcoming '''video game''' in the ''[[Star Wars Jedi]]'' franchise is currently in development, according to a statement by actor [[Cameron Monaghan]] (who portrays [[Cal Kestis]], the main character in the series), made at the end of a "''Star Wars: Jedi'' Game Series" panel during the Ocala Comic Con, on [[September 16]], [[2023]].<ref name="Ocala Comic Con" /> On [[September 17]], [[2024]], it was confirmed that the third ''Jedi'' game will be the last installment in the series.<ref name="Final game" />
